vetSays.line: 🛡️ Mabel, Amy, Alper, Fainche and Fatima met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Mabel, Amy, Alper, Fainche, Fatima are hurt.
🛡️ Mabel, Amy, Fatima, Dmitri and Petra met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Amy, Fatima, Dmitri, Petra are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
It saw the opening coming — braced, scar tissue white. Your first strike glances off. (SCARRED: -3 first strike)
Wanjiru strikes the Scarred White Noise.
Mabel strikes the Scarred White Noise.
The Scarred White Noise falls.
📺 +20 style — dropped the Scarred White Noise!
📺 You brought down Scarred White Noise. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 You brought down Scarred White Noise.
🛡️ Mabel, Amy, Alper, Fainche and Fatima met them at the door — 4 put down, 1 driven off. Mabel, Alper, Fainche, Fatima are hurt.
⚠ This one is different — old, patient, unhurried — it has seen your kind before. An Elder veteran.
Wanjiru strikes the Elder Judge Hoot.
Mabel strikes the Elder Judge Hoot.
The Elder Judge Hoot falls.
📺 Mabel, Wanjiru brought down Elder Judge Hoot. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
📣 Mabel, Wanjiru brought down Elder Judge Hoot. Together.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Katarina just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mabel, Amy, Fainche, Fatima and Theo met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Mabel, Fainche, Fatima, Theo are hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Katarina just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Amy just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Wanjiru just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

🛡️ Ruth, Sofia and Luis met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Ruth, Luis are hurt.

🛡️ Sofia, Brian, Luis and Shabana met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off, 2 barely walked away. Sofia, Brian, Luis, Shabana are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sofia just put down Chorus Line... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Luis just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sofia, Luis and Shabana met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Sofia, Shabana are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.

Shabana: "Sofia and Luis blooded the fourth draft's beasts — we all saw it on the cameras. But only 3 of us carry a weapon, and the fifth draft waits until 6 of us do. We need more hands armed, not more speeches."
🛡️ Sofia, Shabana and Borsha met them at the door — 1 put down. Shabana, Borsha didn't come back. Sofia is hurt.
